title: Flower Shop
summary: An e-commerce app for a flower delivery business, built on Clean Architecture with CQRS. Admins, deliverers, customers and guests each get their own tools, from catalog management and delivery assignment to order tracking, loyalty points and ratings.

title: Dental clinic management system
summary: A management system for a dental clinic with separate roles for administrators, dentists and nurses. It covers patient records, appointment scheduling with dentist availability, a service catalog with prices and durations, staff work schedules and reports on performed services.

title: Cinema management system
summary: A cinema management system inspired by Cineplexx. Admins plan screenings and design hall seat layouts with VIP zones, staff handle reservations at the counter, and users pick seats on a visual hall map, book tickets with simulated payment and rate the movies they've seen.

title: Sunglasses shop
summary: A plain and simple e-commerce app in ASP.NET MVC with a cart, checkout, order tracking, reviews, ratings and a simple ticket system.

title: Catering service
summary: My only project in Spring Boot and Thymeleaf, built to look like a full-fledged website with a simulated cart and checkout.

title: ZNAMO redesign
summary: A redesign of the existing website of the company ZNAMO, with Laravel on the backend and plain TypeScript and SCSS on the frontend.
